Many of these antique American pocket watches come from pawn shops where the gold or silver case was scrapped for its precious metal value, leaving this piece of history discarded. Our watchmakers restored the beautiful Illinois Autocrat movement and did their best to preserve the authenticity of the dial while leaving this patina. Interestingly enough, 1923 was the year that Caterpillar Tractor Company was started in Peoria, Illinois, just down the street from Springfield where this movement was manufactured. We used our machined steel case and crown to house this beauty and not take away from the art that is the dial.

watches.name: The Lancaster 081 (43mm)
watches.description: What makes the Lancaster 081 unique: The Lancaster 081 is one of those watches that just works in almost any scenario. It works well with a brown strap, and would be dressed up on a black strap, and if we found a blue strap to match the hands, that'd work pretty great too! And that's all before you realize this watch houses a pocket watch movement dial and hands all originally made in 1937 by the Hamilton Watch Company in Lancaster, Pennsylvania. With that fact, it's a true conversation piece. We decided to keep this one simple and use our machined stainless steel case and crown. We did not polish the steel, so if you look closely at the bezel or case, you can see the tool marks from our CNC machine cutting those pieces from solid blocks of 316 stainless. Another level of story is contained in that metal... a story of Made in USA. This 17-jewel movement was manufactured in 1937 which is the same year that General Motors built the first mass-produced automatic transmission engine. The "Hydra-Matic" would debut in 1940 model cars, but imagine wearing this pocket watch built in Pennsylvania driving down the streets of Detroit in one of the first prototypes of an automatic car. Pretty spectacular, and pretty darn American.

watches.name: The Springfield 114 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 114 unique: We had some fun with the Springfield 114. When we first saw the patina on the numerals of this antique pocket watch dial, we figured we should use a bronze crown in order to accentuate and proliferate that into the rest of the watch. We also wanted to frame the dial with something that fit well with the interesting geometric pattern of the sub-dial, so we used a scalloped bezel. We also polished the scalloped bezel to add another layer and really showcase the patina on the dial. This 17-jewel movement, dial and hands were originally manufactured by the Illinois Watch Company in 1932, which is the same year the first Zippo lighter was created by George Blaisdell. Another iconic American brand, Zippo, unlike Illinois Watch Co, is still around today and still has a lifetime guarantee. Do you think anyone has an original 1932 Zippo that still works... For the rest of this watch, we used a stainless steel case, and our beautiful Horween Shell Cordovan strap in Oxblood. The combination of colors really works and makes this dial pop.

watches.name: The Lancaster 077 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Lancaster 077 unique: The Lancaster 077 is a masterful blend of ornate beauty and early 20th-century precision. At its core is an original 1924 Hamilton movement, crafted during an era when American watchmaking was the gold standard. The dial’s intricate details immediately capture attention—an aged silver-tone surface is accented by an engraved decorative wreath motif encircling the center. Stylized, elongated numerals balance vintage elegance with bold legibility, while heat-blued hands sweep across the dial with timeless grace. A recessed subdial at six o’clock rounds out the composition, ensuring both symmetry and utility. Powering this timepiece is a 17-jewel manual-wind movement, meticulously produced by the Hamilton Watch Company in Lancaster, Pennsylvania. In 1924, as this movement began its journey, the U.S. Army Air Service circumnavigated the globe for the first time, completing a historic 175-day flight. This pioneering feat mirrored Hamilton’s own pursuit of precision, as the brand was already the trusted supplier of timepieces for the railroads and military, ensuring that those venturing into the unknown could rely on American-made accuracy. Encased in sandblasted stainless steel, the Lancaster 077 is built to withstand the test of time while retaining a subtle, matte finish that complements the vintage dial. A robust onion-style crown provides a tactile winding experience, while the American-made leather strap in warm chestnut brown adds a final touch of classic refinement. With each glance at your wrist, the Lancaster 077 offers a reminder of an era when craftsmanship and exploration pushed boundaries—and a promise that those values endure today.

watches.name: The Springfield 115 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 115 unique: The Springfield 115 is a refined union of early 20th-century railroad precision and modern craftsmanship. Powered by an original 1922 Illinois Watch Company movement, this timepiece pays homage to the era when accuracy was paramount, and railroads demanded the finest timekeeping. The pristine white porcelain dial is adorned with bold black numerals and a subtle outer minute track, evoking the precision required for rail schedules. Delicate blue steel hands sweep across the dial, while the “Santa Fe Special” script reminds us of the proud partnership between timekeeping and the great American railways. A classic subdial at six o’clock punctuates the design with a perfect balance of form and function. Beneath the dial lies a 21-jewel manual-wind movement, crafted in Springfield, Illinois—a hub of American watchmaking excellence. In 1922, as this movement came to life, the nation celebrated the dedication of the Lincoln Memorial in Washington, D.C., honoring one of America’s greatest leaders. Just as that monument stands as a testament to resilience and unity, this watch stands as a tribute to the precision and craftsmanship that defined American industry. Encased in tumbled titanium, the Springfield 115 balances rugged durability with understated elegance. The knurled crown at 3 o'clock offers a different winding experience than most Vortic watches, while the American-made blue leather strap provides a contemporary pop of color, complementing the blue steel hands. The Springfield 115 is more than a timepiece; it is a piece of American history, built to be worn and cherished for generations.

watches.name: The Lancaster 078 (43mm)
watches.description: What makes the Lancaster 078 unique: The Lancaster 078 is a striking blend of mid-century American craftsmanship and modern precision. At its heart lies a 1948 Hamilton Watch Company movement, meticulously restored to honor its rich history. The copper-tone dial commands attention with its warm, sunburst finish, while the luminous gold numerals and classic railroad minute track add depth and readability. Elegant heat-blued cathedral hands glide across the dial, ensuring a touch of vintage refinement. A small seconds subdial at six o’clock completes the composition, creating a timepiece that exudes both character and heritage. Beneath its stunning exterior, the Lancaster 078 is powered by a 21-jewel manual-wind movement, originally crafted in Lancaster, Pennsylvania—a city once known as the epicenter of precision watchmaking in America. In 1948, as this movement was being produced, the nation witnessed the launch of the first Polaroid instant camera, revolutionizing the way people captured memories. Just as that innovation changed photography, Hamilton's commitment to precision and reliability helped shape the legacy of American horology. Encased in machined stainless steel with a polished finish, this watch is built for both durability and sophistication. A robust, knurled crown allows for precise winding, while the American-made black leather strap provides a timeless pairing. With a seamless blend of historical significance and modern craftsmanship, the Lancaster 078 is more than a watch—it’s a tribute to a golden era of American innovation.

watches.name: The Rockford 006 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Rockford 006 unique: The Rockford 006 is a striking blend of early 20th-century craftsmanship and modern refinement. This watch features a 1910 Rockford Watch Company movement, carefully restored to maintain its historical significance. The porcelain dial is a picture of elegance, with bold black numerals and delicate red minute markers encircling the chapter ring. The heat-blued steel hands add a rich contrast, creating a timepiece that is both visually captivating and mechanically exceptional. A classic subdial at six o’clock offers a timeless touch, reinforcing the heritage of this remarkable piece. Powering the Rockford 006 is a 17-jewel, manual-wind movement from the Rockford Watch Company, a testament to the ingenuity of American watchmaking in the early 1900s. As this movement was being crafted in 1910, the United States saw rapid industrial progress, with Henry Ford introducing the first moving assembly line—revolutionizing American manufacturing forever. This spirit of innovation and craftsmanship lives on in every detail of the Rockford 006. Encased in brushed bronze with a coin-edge bezel, this watch exudes vintage character with a modern twist. The knurled crown ensures a tactile, precise winding experience, while the American-made brown leather strap enhances its warm tones. Whether worn as a statement piece or a daily companion, the Rockford 006 embodies the legacy of American excellence, making it more than just a watch—it’s a story on your wrist.

watches.name: The Springfield 116 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 116 unique: A true testament to the elegance and precision of early 20th-century American craftsmanship, The Springfield 116 is a masterpiece reborn. This stunning wristwatch features an original 1924 Illinois Watch Company movement, meticulously restored to preserve its historical integrity. The dial, with its intricate octagonal motif and refined patina, tells a story of timeless sophistication. The black numerals, delicately outlined against the textured silver background, exude vintage charm, while the heat-blued steel hands add a touch of brilliance to the design. A small seconds subdial at six o’clock completes this harmonious composition, capturing the attention of any discerning collector. At its heart is a 21-jewel manual-wind movement from Illinois Watch Company, revered for its precision and durability. Handcrafted in Springfield, Illinois, this movement is a proud relic of American ingenuity during the golden age of watchmaking. In 1924, as this movement was being produced, the U.S. economy boomed, and technological advancements like the first Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade in New York captured the nation’s imagination. The Springfield 116 carries this spirit of innovation and celebration into the modern era. Encased in machined stainless steel with a coin-edge bezel and a knurled crown, The Springfield 116 strikes the perfect balance between durability and refinement. Paired with an American-made tobacco leather strap, its understated elegance ensures versatility for any occasion. From the meticulous craftsmanship to its historical provenance, this watch is not just a timepiece but a legacy on your wrist.

watches.name: The Chicago 072 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Chicago 072 unique: The Chicago 072 is a striking blend of classic design and modern craftsmanship, featuring a pinstriped dial with an elegant vertical texture that catches the light beautifully. Raised gold numerals add warmth and depth, complementing the blued steel hands that sweep across the face with precision. The small seconds subdial, placed at six o’clock, provides a balanced focal point, reinforcing the timeless symmetry of this vintage piece. At its core, this watch is powered by a 17-jewel manual-wind Elgin movement, originally manufactured in 1927. The movement boasts intricate engravings, gold-plated gears, and polished steel components, all visible through the exhibition case back. Jewel settings, often made of brass or gold-plated material, ensure smooth operation while reducing friction. This movement was produced during a pivotal time in American history—1927 saw Charles Lindbergh’s historic solo flight across the Atlantic, a feat of engineering and endurance that mirrors the innovation found in this Elgin timepiece. Encased in machined stainless steel, the Chicago 072 is built for longevity while maintaining a refined aesthetic. The angled polished steel bezel adds a touch of sophistication, while the knurled crown provides easy grip and a tactile connection to its mechanical roots. A navy blue leather strap ties the design together, enhancing the deep blue hues of the hands and reinforcing the watch’s distinct character.

watches.name: The Boston 034 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Boston 034 unique: The Boston 034 is a remarkable tribute to timeless craftsmanship, beginning with its patina-rich cream-colored dial. Bold embossed numerals and striking blue-steeled hands stand out against the aged surface, highlighting the character and story of this 1929 original. The subtle weathering across the dial adds depth and charm, making each glance a journey into history. Beneath the dial lies a 19-jewel manual-wind Waltham movement, showcasing engraved bridges, gold-plated gears, and polished brass jewel settings. These intricate details reflect the precision and durability of American watchmaking during the late 1920s. That same year, as the Great Depression began, the Museum of Modern Art (MoMA) opened in New York City, symbolizing resilience and a commitment to innovation. Encased in a machined stainless steel case with a distinctive scalloped bezel, the Boston 034 marries durability with elegance. The knurled crown offers ease of use while complementing the watch’s vintage-inspired design. Paired with a warm brown leather strap, this timepiece is a versatile and sophisticated addition to any collection.

watches.name: The Lancaster 073 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Lancaster 073 unique: The Lancaster 073 radiates timeless elegance with its intricately pinstriped dial, offering a textured silver backdrop that catches the light beautifully. Raised golden numerals glimmer against the polished surface, while the striking blued steel hands add a pop of color and vintage charm. The subdial at six o’clock, with its concentric circular detailing, enhances the overall balance and functionality of the dial. Inside, a 19-jewel Hamilton manual-wind movement from 1929 continues the legacy of American precision. Its Geneva-striped bridges, golden accents, and intricate engravings make it as visually captivating as it is technically exceptional. This movement is a masterpiece of resilience and design from the roaring ‘20s, when American watchmaking was at its peak. Encased in brushed stainless steel, the polished angled bezel subtly frames the dial, while the knurled steel crown offers a practical yet stylish touch. Completing the look is an ebony leather strap, its smooth finish and stitched accents adding a refined, modern edge to this vintage-inspired piece.

watches.name: The Lancaster 080 (43mm)
watches.description: What makes the Lancaster 080 unique: The Lancaster 080 blends vintage elegance with precision craftsmanship in a compact 43mm stainless steel case, making it the smallest piece in our American Artisan Series. The creamy, aged dial features the iconic Packard Car Company logo—a regal insignia reading “Ask the man who owns one,” a motto synonymous with quality and prestige in the mid-20th century. Gilded Arabic numerals and gold-tone spade hands lend warmth to the design, while the subdial at 6 o’clock completes the watch’s timeless appeal. Powered by a 21-jewel Hamilton manual wind movement from 1948, this piece is among the youngest pocket watches ever converted by Vortic. The expertly restored mechanism maintains the precision Hamilton was renowned for, with polished gears and bridges visible through the exhibition case back. This movement underscores Hamilton’s reputation for producing durable and dependable timekeeping instruments. Housed in a machined stainless steel case with a brushed finish, The Lancaster 080 exudes understated sophistication. The fluted crown ensures effortless winding, while the brown leather strap adds a warm, complementary tone to the piece. With its compact size and historical significance, this watch is a celebration of mid-century design and American manufacturing ingenuity.

watches.name: The Lancaster 075 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Lancaster 075 unique: The Lancaster 075 is a stunning tribute to American innovation, combining horological mastery with automotive heritage. Its brushed champagne dial features bold, applied numerals with an aged patina, and at its heart is the iconic “Ask the Man Who Owns One” insignia—a slogan celebrated by the Packard Motor Car Company. This detail pays homage to a bygone era when style and precision were paramount in both watches and automobiles. At its core is a meticulously restored 19-jewel Hamilton movement, originally crafted in 1931. Known for their exceptional reliability, Hamilton movements were a cornerstone of American watchmaking during the early 20th century. This particular mechanism has been carefully restored to ensure it operates flawlessly while preserving its original craftsmanship and history. The tumbled titanium case offers modern durability with vintage elegance. A smooth bezel, grooved titanium crown, and camel-colored leather strap complete the watch’s refined look, making it perfect for any occasion. The Packard connection—whether a gift to owners or employees—cements this piece as a timeless celebration of ingenuity and design.

watches.name: The Indiana 010 (47mm)
watches.description: What makes the Indiana 010 unique: The Indiana 010 is a remarkable timepiece that intertwines American automotive and watchmaking history. With its distinguished Studebaker insignia, this watch pays homage to two iconic South Bend institutions—the South Bend Watch Company and the Studebaker Corporation—whose shared history embodies innovation and craftsmanship. Its design and legacy make it a powerful symbol of American ingenuity. At the heart of this watch is a South Bend 21-jewel manual-wind movement, originally crafted in 1928. The movement proudly bears the Studebaker name, highlighting the partnership between these two South Bend companies. Studebaker, renowned for its groundbreaking automobiles, and the South Bend Watch Company, celebrated for their precision timepieces, shared a commitment to excellence that is evident in this piece. The sandblasted stainless steel case beautifully frames the golden-hued dial, which features bold black numerals, vibrant red accents, and striking blued steel hands. Complemented by a rugged brown leather strap, this watch blends vintage charm with modern durability, making it as timeless as the legacies it celebrates.

watches.name: The Lancaster 076 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Lancaster 076 unique: The Lancaster 076 is a timeless homage to American craftsmanship and automotive prestige. Its creamy dial is adorned with the iconic insignia “Ask the Man Who Owns One,” a phrase synonymous with the Packard Motor Car Company, reflecting excellence and elegance “of a distinguished family.” This historical connection pays tribute to Packard’s legacy as a premier luxury automaker. At its heart lies a 19-jewel manual-wind Hamilton movement, crafted in 1932, boasting unparalleled precision and refinement. Its gold-accented engraving complements the warm tones of the bronze machined case. The coin-edge bezel and knurled bronze crown enhance its vintage appeal, while the cognac leather strap adds a touch of modern sophistication. As the United States grappled with the Great Depression in 1932, Hamilton’s dedication to quality stood resilient, symbolizing perseverance and artistry. The Lancaster 076 bridges this storied past with modern watchmaking excellence, offering collectors a wearable piece of history.

watches.name: The Chicago 073 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Chicago 073 unique: The Chicago 073 commands attention with its clean, striking white dial, highlighted by bold Roman numerals and the iconic Chevrolet emblem proudly displayed at its center. This unique partnership with the Chevrolet brand bridges the gap between automotive history and horological artistry, paying homage to the legacy of American innovation. The dial’s blued steel kite hands and elegant subdial at 6 o’clock bring a refined balance to the watch’s timeless design. Beneath its impeccable exterior lies a 15-jewel manual-wind movement, originally manufactured by the Elgin National Watch Company in 1924. This movement, like the Chevrolet emblem, represents a period of remarkable American craftsmanship, blending precision with durability. Encased in a machined stainless steel case with a coin-edged bezel, the movement is displayed through a sapphire crystal exhibition caseback, showcasing its intricate engineering. Completing the design is a knurled stainless steel crown and a striking blue leather strap, which perfectly complements the watch’s polished finish. The Chicago 073 is a true celebration of two great American legacies, making it a standout piece for any collector who values history, craftsmanship, and innovation.

watches.name: The Indiana 011 (47mm)
watches.description: What makes the Indiana 011 unique: The Indiana 011 pays homage to a rich legacy of American innovation, starting with its weathered dial that proudly bears the “Studebaker” name. This centerpiece nods to the partnership between South Bend Watch Company and the iconic Studebaker automotive brand, which defined an era of quality and craftsmanship. Bold black numerals, red accents on the outer track, and elegant spade-style hands create a dial design that balances vintage charm with precision. Powering this timepiece is a 21-jewel manual-wind movement, crafted by South Bend Watch Company in 1925. The engraved “Studebaker” on the movement reflects their shared dedication to mechanical ingenuity, much like Studebaker’s innovative automobiles. The movement’s intricate detailing and visible mechanics, displayed through the exhibition case back, are a tribute to the meticulous artistry that South Bend and Studebaker embodied. This watch is housed in a sleek machined titanium case, offering modern strength with a smooth bezel that frames the dial perfectly. A knurled bronze crown adds a touch of warmth, while the oxblood Horween leather strap ties the design together with timeless elegance. The Indiana 011 is more than a watch—it’s a celebration of two pioneering American legacies, brought together in a timepiece that exudes history and craftsmanship.

watches.name: The Lancaster 001 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Lancaster 001 unique: The Lancaster 001 is a masterclass in American legacy, showcasing an exquisite cream-colored dial adorned with the phrase “Ask the Man Who Owns One.” This iconic slogan was famously associated with the Packard Motor Company—a hallmark of excellence and sophistication during the early 20th century. The detailed insignia lends an air of prestige and history to this timepiece, making it a conversation starter for collectors and enthusiasts alike. At the heart of this piece is a 1936 Hamilton 21-jewel movement, celebrated for its precision and resilience. The beautifully striped bridges and intricate engravings reflect Hamilton’s superior craftsmanship, embodying the golden age of American watchmaking. Encased in machined titanium with a smooth steel bezel and a bronze knurled crown, the Lancaster 001 achieves the perfect balance of durability and elegance. Packard’s iconic motto symbolized unrivaled quality, much like this watch, which captures the timeless essence of innovation and distinction.

watches.name: The Springfield 106 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 106 unique: The Springfield 106 is a striking example of American watchmaking excellence, featuring the rare “Santa Fe Special” insignia prominently displayed on both the dial and the restored 1920 Illinois movement. This designation was historically associated with the Atchison, Topeka, and Santa Fe Railway, known for its commitment to punctuality and precision. Watches bearing this name were often used by railway workers who needed to rely on accurate timekeeping during their journeys across America’s expansive rail network. The dial of the Springfield 106 boasts a pristine white finish accented by bold black numerals, a striking red outer minute track, and blued steel hands that evoke a sense of timeless elegance. The balanced design is completed by a sub-seconds dial at 6 o’clock, reinforcing the watch’s purpose-driven heritage. Encased in machined stainless steel with a coin-edge bezel and a knurled crown, this timepiece blends vintage craftsmanship with modern durability. In 1920—the year this pocket watch movement was produced—the U.S. experienced significant milestones, including the completion of the 19th Amendment, which granted women the right to vote. This era of progress and change mirrors the Springfield 106’s timeless legacy of precision and innovation.

watches.name: The Cleveland 006 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Cleveland 006 unique: The Cleveland 006 is a distinguished example of American watchmaking heritage. Its vintage Ball Watch Company dial is a stunning work of art, showcasing intricate floral engravings at the center that contrast beautifully with the warm champagne-toned backdrop. The sleek black numerals and gold-tone kite hands elevate the design with sophistication, while the sub-seconds display at 6 o’clock adds a classic touch of precision. Housed in a machined bronze case with an angled bezel and a knurled bronze crown, this watch offers a balance of durability and elegance. The black Horween leather strap, accented with contrast stitching, enhances its refined aesthetic, making it a timeless addition to any collection. At the heart of the Cleveland 006 is a meticulously restored 19-jewel Ball movement from 1926—crafted during a pivotal era when Ball movements were renowned for setting railroad timekeeping standards. In that same year, the world witnessed the iconic Route 66 being established, symbolizing innovation and exploration. This historical milestone mirrors the enduring craftsmanship and precision found in the Cleveland 006—a true celebration of history and engineering excellence.

watches.name: The Boston 033 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Boston 033 unique: The Boston 033 embodies the refined elegance of late 19th-century American watchmaking. Featuring a crisp white dial with bold black numerals and a striking red minute track, this design emphasizes readability and style. The sub-seconds display at 6 o’clock enhances the dial’s balanced aesthetic, while the sleek blued steel hands add a sophisticated pop of color. At the core of this timepiece is an original 17-jewel Waltham movement, meticulously restored and dating back to 1896—making this watch one of the oldest conversions in our collection. Waltham’s renowned precision and craftsmanship are preserved in every component of this manual-wind movement, reflecting the brand’s pivotal role in American horology. Encased in brushed stainless steel with a smooth bezel and a knurled steel crown, the Boston 033 marries vintage charm with modern durability. The camel-colored leather strap complements the polished design, creating a warm, timeless look. Notably, 1896 was the year the Dow Jones Industrial Average was first published, marking a new era of progress and innovation—a fitting parallel to this extraordinary timepiece that honors history while standing the test of time.

watches.name: The Cleveland 005 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Cleveland 005 unique: The Cleveland 005 is a masterful blend of bold design and American watchmaking heritage. The vintage Ball Watch Company dial commands attention with its unique combination of textures and elegant details. The ornate center engraving, reminiscent of classical motifs, is beautifully complemented by sleek black numerals and blued steel hands. A sub-seconds display at 6 o’clock adds balance and function, while the overall composition exudes timeless sophistication. Beneath the dial, a meticulously restored 19-jewel manual-wind movement, originally crafted in 1926 by Ball Watch Company, powers this exceptional piece. Known for their precision and reliability, Ball movements were integral to railroad timekeeping standards—a testament to their legacy of accuracy and performance. Encased in rugged tumbled titanium with an angled bezel, the Cleveland 005 marries durability with elegance. The knurled DLC-coated steel crown adds a modern touch, while the ebony Horween leather strap enhances the watch’s bold yet refined aesthetic. In 1926, the year this movement was manufactured, the U.S. experienced rapid innovation and expansion, highlighted by the first transatlantic flight by Richard Byrd and Floyd Bennett. This era of exploration and precision mirrors the Cleveland 005’s celebration of engineering excellence and timeless design.

watches.name: The Chicago 070 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Chicago 070 unique: The Chicago 070 boasts a captivating dial that radiates vintage charm and character. The textured, patinaed dial features vertical stripe engraving and bold, aged numerals that tell a story of over a century of use. The stunning blued hands, including classic kite-shaped hour and minute hands, provide a subtle contrast to the dial’s warm tones, making this piece both elegant and timeless. A traditional seconds subdial at the 6 o’clock position completes the design with a touch of classic sophistication. Underneath the dial lies an authentic Elgin movement from 1919, crafted with 17 jewels for smooth and reliable operation. This manually wound mechanism reflects the precision engineering and attention to detail that defined American watchmaking during the early 20th century. Encased in a tumbled stainless steel case with a rugged bronze crown, this watch exudes durability and style. The warm brown leather strap ties the entire piece together, creating a harmonious blend of vintage aesthetics and modern craftsmanship. The Chicago 070 is a true celebration of American horological history, ready to stand the test of time on your wrist.

watches.name: The Springfield 105 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 105 unique: The Springfield 105 is a sophisticated timepiece that perfectly encapsulates the elegance and craftsmanship of early 20th-century American watchmaking. The finely textured silver dial, adorned with bold black numerals and rich blue kite hands, exudes timeless charm. Its patina—a testament to its nearly century-long journey—provides a beautiful backdrop for its classic sub-seconds display. At its heart is an Illinois Watch Company movement from 1922, proudly engraved with “The Fifth Avenue.” This designation highlights the watch’s original premium status, as it was marketed to embody prestige and refinement. “The Fifth Avenue” branding nods to the luxurious appeal associated with New York City’s iconic avenue, where elegance and quality were paramount. With 19 meticulously restored jewels, this manual-wind movement remains a testament to Illinois Watch Company’s dedication to precision and durability. Encased in machined stainless steel with a coin-edge bezel, the Springfield 105 blends durability with refined detail. The knurled crown complements the case’s polished finish, while the warm, chocolate brown leather strap adds a touch of richness to the overall design. The Springfield 105 is more than a timepiece—it’s a celebration of history, craftsmanship, and enduring style, ideal for collectors and enthusiasts alike.

watches.name: The Boston 032 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Boston 032 unique: The Boston 032 is a masterclass in visual contrast, where bold black and crisp white collide in perfect harmony. The striking dial draws you in with its sharp black outer ring framing a pristine white center, making the black hands and detailed minute track pop. The distinctive secometer subdial at 6 o’clock adds a dynamic touch, ensuring this design stands out at every glance. Beneath the surface lies a meticulously restored 1924 Waltham movement with 21 jewels, a testament to the enduring quality of American watchmaking. This manually wound marvel ensures precision and reliability, keeping the spirit of its era alive. Encased in a rugged tumbled titanium case with an angled bezel, the Boston 032 balances toughness with refinement. The stainless steel crown and classic black leather strap complete the look, amplifying the contrast and making this watch a showstopper on any wrist. This is more than just a timepiece — it’s a bold statement of style and heritage.

watches.name: The Springfield 100 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 100 unique: The Springfield 100 features a radiant gold dial with a captivating checkered sunburst design, embodying the elegance of early 20th-century craftsmanship. The warmth of the dial is beautifully contrasted by bold black numerals and blued kite hands, creating a striking visual appeal. A sub-second dial at six o’clock adds a functional, vintage charm to this historic piece. At the heart of this watch beats a 23-jewel Illinois Watch Company movement from 1921, representing precision and durability. This manual-wind movement, expertly restored, reflects the pinnacle of American watchmaking heritage, blending historical significance with modern reliability. The warm tones of the gold dial, bronze crown, and camel-colored leather strap stand out against the sleek machined stainless steel case and refined coin-edge bezel. This interplay of materials adds depth and character, making the Springfield 100 a perfect fusion of vintage aesthetics and modern craftsmanship. A true celebration of American horology.

watches.name: The Springfield 103 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 103 unique: The Springfield 103 is a statement piece destined to ring in the New Year with timeless style and craftsmanship. The stunning dial features a bold, eye-catching combination of black and intricate engravings, creating a captivating contrast that immediately draws the eye. The ornate central engraving reveals a floral motif that reflects the elegance of a bygone era, while the polished numerals add a touch of refinement. Complementing this artistry are the blued kite hands, offering a vibrant pop against the deep black dial and ensuring legibility with classic flair. Powering this timepiece is a meticulously restored Illinois Watch Company movement from 1926, equipped with 21 jewels for precision and durability. Originally designed to keep accurate time in the pocket, this manual wind movement has been reimagined to thrive on your wrist. The case is crafted from machined titanium with a brushed finish, while a polished coin-edge titanium bezel adds sophistication. A knurled crown ensures easy winding, and the watch is completed by a classic black Horween leather strap with elegant stitching for a refined finish. This Springfield 103 celebrates history, craftsmanship, and modern engineering—ready to accompany you into the New Year and beyond.

watches.name: The Springfield 082 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 082 unique: Introducing the Springfield 082 — a stunning conversion that bridges history and modern craftsmanship. This watch features a pristine white dial, showcasing bold black numerals and elegant blued kite hands that provide a touch of sophistication. The crisp, minimalistic design allows for effortless readability, and the subtle seconds subdial at six o’clock adds a layer of classic charm. Encased in a machined titanium case with a smooth bezel, this piece offers durability and contemporary appeal. The knurled titanium crown provides a robust finishing detail, seamlessly complementing the case’s finish. Paired with a cognac-colored leather strap, this American-made creation exudes timeless elegance and comfort. Powering this watch is a 19-jewel manual wind movement, originally manufactured by Illinois Watch Company in 1922. With its meticulous engineering, this historic movement offers reliability and a tangible connection to early 20th-century American watchmaking. The Springfield 082 is more than just a timepiece; it’s a tribute to heritage, quality, and craftsmanship — a perfect blend of history and modernity ready to be worn and cherished for generations.

watches.name: The Chicago 067 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Chicago 067 unique: The Chicago 067 is a stunning blend of craftsmanship and history, featuring a dial that draws immediate attention with its intricate, embossed design at the center. This ornate pattern showcases fine detailing reminiscent of a bygone era, with gold Art Deco numerals that beautifully complement the texture and layout of the dial. The classic blued kite hands add a touch of elegance and provide clear readability against the dial’s rich silver tones. Powering this watch is an Elgin movement originally manufactured in 1927. This manual wind movement contains 17 jewels, ensuring reliable and smooth operation. The legacy of Elgin Watch Company is celebrated for its precision and durability, making this movement a testament to early 20th-century American horology. The watch is housed in a machined stainless steel case with a coin-edge bezel that adds subtle sophistication. The knurled stainless steel crown provides a tactile finishing touch, enhancing the overall utility of the design. Completing the aesthetic is a rich Oxblood Horween leather strap with stitching, adding comfort and timeless appeal. This piece seamlessly merges historical charm with modern engineering—a classic that honors the legacy of American watchmaking.

watches.name: The Lancaster 072 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Lancaster 072 unique: The Lancaster 072 boasts a captivating, warm-toned dial that radiates rich patina, offering a glimpse into nearly 90 years of history. The standout secometer subdial is a rare and distinctive feature, nodding to the innovative ‘Secometer’ designs produced by Hamilton in the 1930s. Bold, black numerals and elegant black spade hands complete the vintage-inspired design, while the dial’s subtle aging adds authenticity and charm. Inside, the watch is powered by a 17-jewel manual wind movement from Hamilton Watch Company, crafted in 1935. This movement represents the excellence of American watchmaking, delivering reliable performance and a connection to a bygone era of horology. The watch is housed in a tumbled titanium case with a rugged, angled titanium bezel that enhances its durability and modern appeal. A knurled bronze crown adds a warm, complementary accent to the case, blending past and present materials seamlessly. Paired with a classic Cognac leather strap, this piece perfectly balances vintage aesthetics and contemporary craftsmanship, making it a worthy addition to any collection.

watches.name: The Springfield 101 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 101 unique: This Springfield 101 showcases a dial rich with character, its speckled patina and worn numerals telling the story of nearly a century of use since its creation in 1926. The blued kite hands glide elegantly across the ornate dial, which features an intricate pattern and bold numerals. Every mark and faded detail serves as a testament to this piece’s history and enduring craftsmanship. Inside, this watch houses a 21-jewel manual-wind movement produced by the Illinois Watch Company. The movement proudly bears the “A. Lincoln” designation, a mark reserved for high-grade movements known for precision and reliability. Named in honor of Abraham Lincoln, these movements were crafted to meet exacting standards, reflecting the quality and prestige of early 20th-century American watchmaking. Encased in a machined stainless steel case with a matching stainless steel back, this piece offers durability and a sleek, timeless aesthetic. The robust knurled crown completes the look, providing a functional yet stylish accent. Paired with a classic black leather strap, the Springfield 101 is a harmonious blend of historical significance and modern refinement—a true celebration of American horological heritage.

watches.name: The Chicago 069 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Chicago 069 unique: Celebrate the season with the Chicago 069, a stunning testament to American craftsmanship and Art Deco elegance. The dial of this watch is truly a showstopper — an intricately engraved design evokes a sense of luxury and refinement, while the contrasting gold Art Deco numerals stand boldly against the backdrop, reflecting the timeless sophistication of the Roaring Twenties. Complementing the ornate dial are blued spade hands that add a subtle yet striking touch of color. At the heart of this watch lies a 1924 Elgin movement, renowned for its durability and precision. This manual-wind movement continues to honor the legacy of Elgin’s commitment to quality and reliability, making it an enduring piece of horological history. The case is crafted from machined stainless steel and features a coin-edge bezel for added texture and depth. Topped off with a sandblasted titanium crown and paired with a classic camel leather strap, this watch embodies a harmonious blend of rugged elegance and refined detailing. Whether it’s a gift for a loved one or a treasure for your own collection, the Chicago 069 is a holiday release that captures the magic of history, artistry, and the season of giving.

watches.name: The Cleveland 004 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Cleveland 004 unique: The Cleveland 004 features a captivating dial adorned with rare Art Nouveau numerals and intricate design accents, reflecting the ornate style of the early 20th century. Its radiant sunburst texture adds a dynamic element to the dial, while the blued square spade hands provide a striking contrast, gracefully tracing the passage of time. Beneath this elegant dial lies a Ball Watch Company movement from 1926. This manual-wind mechanism, equipped with 19 jewels, has been meticulously restored to uphold Ball’s reputation for precision and reliability, making it a true marvel of American watchmaking history. Encasing this remarkable movement is a chemically patinaed bronze case that exudes warmth and character, accentuated by an angled bronze bezel. The knurled stainless steel crown adds a subtle touch of contrast, while the watch is completed with a classic black Horween leather strap. This piece harmonizes heritage and craftsmanship, offering a truly distinctive addition to any collection.

watches.name: The Springfield 102 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 102 unique: The Springfield 102 captures the essence of Art Deco elegance and American watchmaking excellence. Its dial features sharp, clean Art Deco numerals, beautifully contrasted by blued square spade hands that reflect a sophisticated aesthetic. The understated design of the dial is complemented by a small seconds subdial, lending a touch of vintage charm to this piece. This watch is housed in a machined titanium case paired with a stainless steel case back, ensuring durability while maintaining a sleek, modern finish. The coin edge bezel adds refined texture, while the vertical-grooved titanium crown provides a cohesive, industrial appeal. Completing the look is a classic black American-made leather strap, offering a timeless pairing to the polished case design. At its heart lies an Illinois movement from 1923 with 23 jewels—a hallmark of precision and quality craftsmanship. This manual-wind movement exemplifies the peak of Illinois Watch Company engineering, designed for accuracy and longevity. The Springfield 102 is a masterful blend of historical artistry, robust materials, and enduring American design.

watches.name: The Springfield 085 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 085 unique: The Springfield 085 is a testament to masterful craftsmanship, seamlessly combining two distinct tones in both its case and dial. The dial, with its gold-toned center contrasted against a warm silver outer ring, exudes timeless elegance. The worn black numerals, reflecting a century of history, and the blued hands—cut in an open kite design—bring a distinguished flair to this striking piece. Encased in a polished stainless steel body with a bronze bezel, this watch captures an artful balance between steel’s enduring strength and bronze’s rustic warmth. A knurled stainless steel crown complements the case, while a bronze buckle secures the American-made oxblood leather strap, adding a cohesive finish to the design. Powering this piece is an original 1922 Illinois Watch Company Autocrat grade movement. Known for its robust design and reliability, the Autocrat was crafted to be a workhorse, often found in high-grade timepieces of the era. This 17-jewel, manual-wind movement features beautifully two-toned plates and intricate engravings visible through the transparent case back. Each tick preserves the legacy of American watchmaking, making the Springfield 085 more than just a timekeeper—it’s a wearable slice of history.

watches.name: The Springfield 092 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 092 unique: This Springfield 092 is a celebration of early 20th-century craftsmanship and artistry. Housed within a polished stainless steel case, this timepiece features an elegant angled bezel and a knurled machined steel crown that showcase Vortic’s dedication to precision engineering and timeless design. What sets this watch apart is its dial — a breathtaking example of artistry that has endured for over a century. The detailed, symmetrical scrollwork gracing the center is remarkably well-preserved, a testament to the quality of its original creation. Complementing this intricate design are blued open kite hands, which elegantly contrast with the warm dial and align perfectly with the classic blue American-made leather strap. This pairing emphasizes the watch’s sophisticated aesthetic while paying homage to its rich history. The manual wind movement, powered by 19 jewels, ensures reliable performance. Originally crafted by the Illinois Watch Company, this piece of American horological history continues to beat with precision. Whether admired for its ornate dial or its enduring mechanics, the Springfield 092 is a striking example of how classic design and modern engineering can coexist beautifully.

watches.name: The Springfield 099 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 099 unique: This Springfield 099 features an early 20th-century Illinois Watch Company movement, a testament to American watchmaking excellence. Encased in a robust steel case with a machined finish, this watch offers durability with a timeless aesthetic. The smooth bezel, also crafted from machined steel, complements the case perfectly, while the knurled steel crown adds a tactile and functional touch. The dial tells its own story, showcasing vertical pinstripes that hint at the watch’s rich history. The worn black numerals reveal subtle signs of age, adding character and authenticity. Completing the design are the blued kite hands, which provide an elegant contrast and enhance the vintage charm of this piece. Paired with a classic black American-made leather strap, the Springfield 099 seamlessly blends historical significance with modern craftsmanship. It’s a distinctive watch that honors the past while standing out in the present—a true reflection of American ingenuity and design.

watches.name: The Springfield 094 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 094 unique: This Springfield 094 brings a quiet confidence to the wrist. The dial, crafted by Illinois Watch Company, showcases a beautifully aged simplicity that tells a story with every glance. The crisp numerals and sub-seconds display stand in sharp contrast to the subtle patina, adding a layer of depth that speaks to its vintage roots. Encased in a machined titanium case, this watch blends durability and understated refinement. The angled bezel with a tumbled titanium finish gives it a rugged yet sophisticated texture, perfectly complemented by the knurled crown made from machined steel. It’s a harmonious combination of industrial precision and vintage charm. The ebony Hadley-Roma strap adds a sleek modern touch, ensuring a seamless blend between past and present. The steel buckle anchors the design, enhancing the monochromatic palette of the piece. This careful balance between classic elements and contemporary craftsmanship makes this Springfield a versatile companion for any collection. With the Springfield 094, history and craftsmanship align, creating a piece that honors the past while feeling entirely relevant today. It’s not just a watch; it’s a reminder of the timeless art of American watchmaking.

watches.name: The Springfield 084 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 084 unique: The Springfield 084 is a striking fusion of rich history and modern craftsmanship. Encased in a machined bronze case, this watch carries a warmth and patina that will only grow more unique with time. The smooth bronze bezel flows seamlessly with the case, giving it a classic yet robust feel. The dial tells its own story, with golden numerals and hands set against a soft patina background, reflecting nearly a century of heritage. The standout feature is the beautifully detailed subdial at 6 o’clock and the unique open-face configuration, offering vintage charm with contemporary appeal. The knurled bronze crown not only complements the case but also provides a tactile and precise winding experience. Paired with an oxblood Horween leather strap with contrast stitching, the Springfield 084 delivers both comfort and rugged sophistication. The matching bronze buckle ties the entire aesthetic together, creating a cohesive and timeless look. Wearing the Springfield 084 feels like connecting with a bygone era while appreciating modern craftsmanship. Each element, from the bronze case to the oxblood Horween strap, is a testament to timeless design and meticulous attention to detail. This piece isn’t just for telling time—it’s for telling stories, honoring history, and making a statement with every wear.

watches.name: The Springfield 089 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 089 unique: The Springfield 089 is a stunning example of vintage elegance paired with modern craftsmanship. The bronze case, finished in a classic standard bronze, radiates warmth and depth. Over time, this case will develop a natural patina, adding unique character and individuality to the watch. The smooth bezel seamlessly complements the case, enhancing its understated sophistication. The dial is a true centerpiece, with its soft patina and bold black Arabic numerals providing a timeless aesthetic. The blued steel hands bring a subtle yet striking contrast, while the small seconds subdial at 6 o’clock ensures both functionality and vintage charm. Adding to the refined details is the vertical-grooved crown, also crafted in bronze, which offers a tactile and satisfying winding experience. The chocolate leather strap from Hadley Roma completes the design with a touch of luxurious comfort, secured by a bronze buckle for a cohesive finish. This watch is more than an accessory—it’s a story of heritage, craftsmanship, and enduring style. Whether you’re adding it to a collection or wearing it daily, the Springfield 089 stands as a testament to timeless design.

watches.name: The Springfield 093 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 093 unique: The Springfield 093 is a beautiful tribute to timeless American watchmaking. Its steel case features a finely machined texture, paired with a coin-edge bezel crafted in matching machined steel for an added touch of elegance. This harmonious design offers both durability and sophistication. The dial is a true standout, with warm gold numerals set against a soft cream backdrop. The intricate detailing on the numerals and the blued steel hands give the watch an unmistakable vintage charm, while the small seconds subdial at 6 o’clock provides a functional and stylish touch. Completing the look is a knurled crown made from machined steel, ensuring precision and ease of use. The black Horween leather strap, accented with contrast stitching, adds a refined yet rugged element, making this piece perfect for any occasion. This watch captures the spirit of its time while standing out as a modern accessory. Whether you’re drawn to its historical roots or its timeless design, the Springfield 093 is a versatile piece that’s as meaningful as it is stylish.

watches.name: The Lancaster 069 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Lancaster 069 unique: The Lancaster 069 is a bold and modern take on a classic American timepiece. Its steel case, finished with a sleek DLC-Black coating, exudes a contemporary elegance. The scalloped bezel, also finished in DLC-Black steel, adds a unique texture that enhances its striking presence. At the heart of this watch lies a beautifully detailed dial with intricate engravings, giving it a sense of artistry and refinement. The gold-toned hands and numerals add a warm contrast against the creamy backdrop, while the small seconds subdial at 6 o’clock ties the design together with vintage charm. The vertical-grooved bronze crown is a standout feature, offering both functionality and a touch of warmth to the overall aesthetic. Paired with a black Horween leather strap with contrast stitching, this watch is as comfortable as it is stylish. The matching bronze buckle completes the cohesive design. The Lancaster 069 is more than just a timepiece; it’s a statement of individuality and craftsmanship, blending modern finishes with a deep respect for watchmaking heritage.

watches.name: The Springfield 098 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 098 unique: The Springfield 098 is a watch that tells its story with bold character and vintage charm. Its machined steel case is paired with a coin-edge bezel finished in polished steel, offering a perfect balance of rugged refinement and subtle sophistication. The dial is an absolute standout, featuring an aged patina that brings a sense of history to the forefront. Black Arabic numerals and the small seconds subdial at 6 o’clock provide clarity and a classic layout, while the intricate detailing adds a unique character to this timepiece. The knurled crown, crafted from machined steel, ensures a precise and satisfying winding experience. The chocolate leather strap from Hadley Roma adds a rich warmth to the watch, complemented by the steel buckle for a cohesive finish. The Springfield 098 is more than a watch—it’s a time capsule of American ingenuity, blending modern craftsmanship with a respect for history. It’s a piece that effortlessly transitions from casual wear to a more polished look, making it a versatile addition to any collection. This piece is more than a watch—it’s a connection to history, brought to life with materials and craftsmanship built for today.

watches.name: The Lancaster 065 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Lancaster 065 unique: The Lancaster 065 is a beautiful nod to timeless design and historical craftsmanship. Its bronze case features a standard finish that develops a unique patina over time, adding character and individuality to every wear. The coin-edge bezel in machined steel provides a striking contrast, lending a touch of sophistication to this classic piece. The dial is understated yet elegant, with gold-toned numerals and hands that catch the light effortlessly. The small seconds subdial at 6 o’clock, along with the clean, symmetrical layout, reflects the careful attention to detail that defines this watch. The knurled, machined steel crown ensures a tactile and reliable winding experience. The camel leather strap from Hadley Roma adds warmth to the overall design, complementing the bronze tones perfectly. Finished with a matching bronze buckle, the strap feels as premium as it looks, offering both comfort and style. This Lancaster 065 is more than just a watch—it’s a story on your wrist, blending enduring materials with an appreciation for American watchmaking heritage.

watches.name: The Springfield 080 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 080 unique: The Springfield 080 is a striking combination of bold design and thoughtful craftsmanship. Its titanium case, finished with a tumbled texture, exudes a rugged elegance, while the angled bezel in machined steel adds sharp definition to the overall aesthetic. The dial is nothing short of mesmerizing, featuring a captivating texture that radiates from the center, complemented by bold Arabic numerals and a beautifully integrated small seconds subdial. The blued steel hands provide a stunning contrast, elevating the watch's visual appeal. A standout feature is the knurled bronze crown, which offers a unique touch of warmth and a satisfying winding experience. The camel leather strap from Hadley Roma ties the design together, bringing a soft and inviting tone that perfectly complements the tumbled titanium and bronze elements. Finished with a matching bronze buckle, every detail feels intentional and cohesive. Wearing the Springfield 080 is a celebration of timeless craftsmanship and modern artistry—a piece that feels as at home in a collector's rotation as it does on your wrist every day.

watches.name: The Springfield 083 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 083 unique: The Springfield 083 is a perfect example of understated sophistication paired with meticulous craftsmanship. Its titanium case, with a tumbled finish, offers a subtle texture that speaks to both its durability and its refined aesthetic. The angled bezel, also finished in tumbled titanium, adds an extra layer of depth, seamlessly complementing the watch's overall design. At the heart of this piece lies its striking dial, featuring a textured pattern that catches the light beautifully. The black Arabic numerals stand out clearly, while the small seconds subdial at 6 o'clock offers both vintage charm and functional elegance. The vertically grooved, tumbled titanium crown enhances the tactile experience of winding the watch, a thoughtful nod to classic watchmaking traditions. Completing the look is a rich chocolate leather strap from Hadley Roma, known for its quality and comfort. Paired with a sturdy steel buckle, this strap adds warmth to the titanium case, creating a balanced design suitable for any occasion. The Springfield 083 is more than a watch—it’s a timeless companion, blending modern materials with a deep respect for historical craftsmanship.

watches.name: The Springfield 097 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 097 unique: With its bold titanium case and rich chocolate strap, this watch is a testament to timeless craftsmanship and thoughtful design. The lightweight case features a machined texture that balances modern precision with classic aesthetics, while the smooth, sandblasted steel bezel adds a refined, understated touch. The aged dial carries a warm, speckled texture that echoes the passage of time, paired with bold Arabic numerals for clarity and a small seconds subdial that nods to its vintage roots. Blued steel hands provide a vibrant contrast, giving the dial a pop of color and elegance. Attention to detail continues with the knurled steel crown, making winding both tactile and precise. A rich chocolate leather strap from Hadley Roma completes the look, offering comfort and a touch of modern luxury. This piece is more than a watch—it’s a connection to history, brought to life with materials and craftsmanship built for today.

watches.name: The Springfield 096 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 095 unique: This Illinois A. Lincoln watch seamlessly blends the historical elegance of early 20th-century American watchmaking with modern craftsmanship. Crafted in 1919 by the Illinois Watch Company, it exemplifies a time when precision and artistry were paramount. The watch's dial is a true standout, featuring a captivating guilloché texture and bold Arabic numerals that offer both clarity and charm. A small seconds subdial at 6 o'clock completes the vintage design, creating a delightful balance of function and aesthetics. Its stainless steel case boasts a meticulously machined finish, lending a clean and refined look that complements the vintage movement within. The black leather strap, accented with tan stitching, adds a touch of versatility, making the watch suitable for both formal and casual settings. Wearing this timepiece is more than just a style statement; it's a tribute to American heritage. With its rich history and timeless design, the Illinois A. Lincoln is a meaningful addition to any watch collection.

watches.name: The Springfield 095 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 095 unique: T his week’s featured watch is a timeless transformation of an Illinois movement from 1916 into a wearable masterpiece. Imagine this: over a hundred years ago, a watchmaker in Illinois meticulously assembled this very mechanism, unaware that it would one day find a second life as a modern wristwatch. The golden textured dial immediately catches the eye, evoking the elegance of an Art Deco masterpiece. The vertical grooves draw you in, a reminder of the era’s bold designs and attention to detail. Accentuated by rich blue-steeled hands, the dial feels alive—an understated yet stunning tribute to classic American design. Encased in durable steel, this watch is built to last a lifetime, adding each new adventure you have to the extensive list of stories it can tell. This incredible vintage timepiece, n ow reimagined for the modern collector, features a deep blue leather strap that completes the look, marrying heritage with contemporary style. This watch doesn’t just tell time—it carries the weight of a century’s worth of history. It’s a reminder that craftsmanship, quality, and passion are, no pun intended, completely timeless.

watches.name: The Burlington 006 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Burlington 006 unique: Some classics are classic for a reason, and this one is as classic as they come. The vintage characteristics and modern elements of the Burlington 006 were carefully paired by our expert watchmakers to build a clean and cohesive timepiece with a timeless design. The nearly flawless white dial, bold black Arabic numerals, and antique moon hands comprise a watch face that is as versatile as it is stylish. Whether it's worn under a suit cuff or with a T-shirt and jeans, its no-nonsense aesthetic and high-quality components will stand out and turn heads whenever and wherever the moment brings you. The 45 mm tumbled titanium case has been outfitted with a contrasting polished steel bezel with an angled construction that catches the light and provides a dynamic transition from case to face. The stainless steel crown, machined in-house, was crafted with square knurling with a practical, tactile presence for ease of winding the mainspring of its impressively engineered 21-jewel movement. Although it's 101 years old, the movement, which features a center-bridge construction, is in excellent condition, with crisp engraving, Geneva striping, and intricate decoration. Inside our solid titanium case and visible through a sapphire crystal case back, its double-roller design and robust craftsmanship are ready to meet the demands of the next 101 years.
