watches.name: The Canton 005 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Canton 005 unique: In 1923, after years of collaboration, the Hampden Watch Company and the Dueber Watch Case Company merged to form the Dueber-Hampton Watch Company of Canton, Ohio. The strength of the partnership between these two manufacturers left its mark on the pocket watches they produced. This particular pocket watch, created in 1910, features a highly stylized "Hampden Watch Co" label on the dial and an engraving of the grade name "Dueber Grand" on the movement. Both sides of this now-converted watch are equally stunning - a clean white double-sunk dial is punctuated by bold black numerals and red five-second markings, while the intricately decorated movement with gold accents shows through the open case back. Our machined stainless steel case with polished bezel and a moss leather strap complete this piece.

watches.name: The Springfield 057 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 057 unique: Featuring a 1922 Illinois Watch Company pocket watch, the Springfield 057 preserves and rejuvenates a century-old piece of American history. A distinctive textured white dial with stylized black numerals is paired with blued steel kite hands and a "Roosevelt"-marked movement. We paired this piece with our stainless steel case and crown and matched the hands with a blue leather strap, resulting in a distinctive timepiece with details from every angle.

watches.name: The Boston 017 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Boston 017 unique: Sometimes, the seemingly 'simple' dials are the most fun for us to find and convert because there's so much that we can add to the story. The 1919 Waltham Watch Company pocket watch within the Boston 017 features one such dial, and we love how this conversion turned out! A clean white surface is accentuated by bold black numerals and hash marks and labeled with unique scripting of "Waltham" and "U.S.A." We paired this piece with a two-toned case and bezel/crown combination to add depth and accentuate the gold hands and gears of the 17-jewel movement. The stitching of a cordovan oxblood leather strap continues the gilded theme, resulting in a dignified wristwatch that is sure to attract attention.

watches.name: The Boston 019 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Boston 019 unique: Waltham Watch Company was founded in Waltham, Massachusetts in 1850 and manufactured about 40 million timepieces in its roughly 100-year existence. During that century, the company underwent several name changes, including titles such as the American Horologe Company, the Boston Watch Company, and the American Waltham Watch Company. The 1908 pocket watch we've converted into the Boston 019 is double-signed with the abbreviations of both Waltham and the American Waltham Watch Companies. A pristine white double-sunk dial with slender Roman Numerals and red five-minute figures is accented by blued steel fine spade hands. Just as impressive as the front is the highly decorated 17-jewel movement that has been fully restored by our watchmakers. We finished this piece with our stainless steel case, titanium crown, and tobacco leather strap for a look of timeless sophistication.

watches.name: The Lancaster 035 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Lancaster 035 unique: Hamilton Watch Company produced some incredible, highly decorated dials in its heyday of American manufacturing, but this one may be one of the most stunning we've seen! Originally created in 1933, this glimmering silver dial is shot through with a dramatic Art Deco sunburst design and surrounded by raised gold numerals and a dotted minute track. This dial is mesmerizing in its ability to catch and change colors with the light, and its movement is just as stunning. Boasting 23 jewels with gold settings, this is one of the highest-quality pocket watches out there. We've completed this conversion with our machined stainless steel case and crown and matched the blued steel spear hands with a blue leather strap. This one is not to be missed!

watches.name: The Springfield 056 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 056 unique: Featuring a 1922 Illinois Watch Company pocket watch, the Springfield 056 is a study in contrast. The eye is immediately drawn to the dial's raised gold numerals and kite hands, while a matte stone-colored border surrounds a satin-finished dial center with a delicate leaf pattern. The 17 jewel movement visible through the open case back reveals gold accents and rose gold plated gears. We've accented these metallic elements with a two-toned stainless steel case and bronze bezel and crown and completed the luxurious feel with a stitched cordovan oxblood leather strap.

watches.name: The Springfield 053 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 053 unique: During the 1800s, most American-made pocket watches were made with enamel dials. However, this trend faded in the early 1900s and was replaced by metal dials because of their artistic appearance and durability. The Springfield 053 features a 1925 Illinois Watch Company pocket watch with an Art Deco metal dial, exemplifying the style that made this new material so popular. A matte-finished border surrounds a grooved subdial and butler-finished dial center, while blued steel kite hands circle angular black numerals. The 21 jewel movement is just as impressive with its gold accents and dignified Geneva stripes. We complemented this stunning timepiece with our stainless steel case and crown and a classic black leather strap.

watches.name: The Chicago 046 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Chicago 046 unique: This watch speaks for itself! We've given new life to a 1928 Elgin Watch Company pocket watch with an incredible dial and almost a century of history. A stunning robin's egg blue and gold design pops on a stark white dial with delicate Roman Numerals and blued steel spade hands. We've converted this piece with our stainless steel case, coin-edge bezel, and domed crystal to accent and highlight the artistry within. A stitched black leather strap completes the look. This piece is sure to draw looks and inspire questions.

watches.name: The Boston 018 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Boston 018 unique: Featuring a 1912 American Waltham Watch Company pocket watch, the Boston 018 truly is a conversation starter with layers of detail to discover and share. A clean white double-sunk dial features a rare five minute track and a distinctive font used for the original brand name. Blued steel moon hands accent the classic dial and draw the eye outward to a striking navy leather strap. We've paired this piece with a stainless steel case, polished bezel, and open case back through which you can see the ornately decorated movement.

watches.name: The Springfield 055(45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 055 unique: So many of the Illinois Watch Company pocket watches we find are unique in appearance and markings. That's because, in its 60 years of operation, Illinois produced over 5.5 million pocket watches, many of which were manufactured as private label series or of different configuration models. The 1923 pocket watch within the Springfield 055 is one such exceptional piece. The intricate silver dial center and edge are drastically contrasted by an eye-catching gold background and sub-dial, all spotted with some great patina that reveals the full century this piece has counted. An equally detailed movement displays the word "Vim," indicating one of the numerous model names used by Illinois. We've enclosed this piece in our coin-edged stainless steel case and crown to highlight the spectacular insides and protect this piece of history for another 100 years.

watches.name: The Lancaster 036 (43mm)
watches.description: What makes the Lancaster 036 unique: Featuring a 10-size 1940 pocket watch from Hamilton Watch Company, the Lancaster 029 is a great example of the diversity and enduring style of American watchmaking and manufacturing. At 43mm, this is the smallest conversion we can make, but the impact of this piece is eye-catching nonetheless. Our machined stainless steel case and crown contrast the dial's gold numerals and sharp pointed hands as well as the movement's gold-plated gears visible through the open case back. A natural leather strap draws these finishes out even more, resulting in a watch that is simultaneously luxurious and comfortable.

watches.name: The Springfield 054 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 054 unique: Made from a 1922 Illinois Watch Company pocket watch, this conversion epitomizes the concept of a "statement piece." The eye is immediately drawn to the highly decorated gilded dial center accented by bright blue kite hands and surrounded by bold black Art Nouveau numerals. To highlight the lustrous dial, we've paired this piece with a bronze case, crown, and buckle and completed it with a moss-brown strap. This is a watch with a story to tell!

watches.name: The Springfield 044 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 044 unique: Most American watch manufacturers offered customized, engraved movements for special orders, and the Illinois Watch Company was no exception. The pocket watch within the Springfield 044 was one such private-label piece. Originally produced in 1923 for H.C. Jacobsen & Son, this 17-jewel movement is marked with the trade name "Penn Special". The dial is clean and classic, painted white and accented with black numerals and seconds track and blued steel kite hands. We've preserved this refined timepiece in our sandblasted stainless steel case and paired it with a classic black leather strap.

watches.name: The Canton 004 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Canton 004 unique: The Hampden Watch Company, also known as the Dueber-Hampden Watch Company, was an American watch manufacturer in Canton, Ohio with a tumultuous past. The company changed owners, names, and locations several times, and even burned to the ground in the 1870s. Despite its sometimes rocky history, however, Hampden manufactured incredible timepieces, and the pocket watch in this conversion is no exception. A pristine white double-sunk dial is surrounded by bold black numerals and accented with red five-second markings and blued steel kite hands. The movement is adorned with intricate decorations and gilded inlay, all of which can be seen through the open case back of our polished stainless steel case. We've paired this piece with a classic and comfortable tobacco leather strap.

watches.name: The Boston 016 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Boston 016 unique: Featuring a Waltham Watch Company pocket watch originally manufactured in 1926, The Boston 016 is a preserved piece of Art Deco history. The rare checkered engraving of the 17-jewel movement is mimicked by the textured diamond pattern of the dial, while the font used for 'Waltham' matches that of the numerals. Thin, sharp blued steel hands complete the look. We paired this piece with our sandblasted stainless steel case and crown and oxblood stitched leather strap. This one is for the watch collector who appreciates attention to detail.

watches.name: The Springfield 052 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 052 unique: Perry was a famous US Navy Commodore during the War of 1812. He was made famous for winning the battle of Lake Erie against the British. This pocket watch was originally made in 1917 by the Illinois Watch Company under a private label contract with Otto Young & Co. Otto Young & Co., similarly to Sears Robuck, operated a catalog-based company from 1865-1928 and they sold watchmakers' tools and materials as well as pocket watches. This movement is what we call "double-signed" meaning it says "Commodore Perry" on both the dial and the movement. Double-signed movements like this are extremely rare, especially in this condition. We put it in a DLC-coated black steel case because we thought that would accentuate the black numerals while not detracting from the beauty of the textured dial.

watches.name: The Springfield 049 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 049 unique: Featuring a 1922 Illinois Watch Company pocket watch, the Springfield 049 exemplifies the time-honored design and enduring craftsmanship of American manufacturing. This piece epitomizes class and style with a pristine white single sunk dial, clean black numerals, and blued steel gothic hands. Our stainless steel case and crown, polished bezel, and domed sapphire crystal complete the sleek feel. Wear this hundred-year-old piece of American history with pride - it's sure to last another century at least!

watches.name: The Chicago 044 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Chicago 044 unique: For nearly 100 years, Elgin Watch Company was the world's largest watch manufacturer, and its legacy of craftsmanship and artistry lives on in this incredible piece. The pocket watch in this conversion was manufactured in 1925 and remains in pristine condition. We've paired the ornately decorated dial and gold hands with a bronze case and buckle and stainless steel crown and case back. As bronze, the case and buckle will patina over time, making this piece even more unique.

watches.name: The Boston 015 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Boston 015 unique: The Waltham Watch Company, also known as the American Waltham Watch Company, manufactured about 40 million pocket watches, clocks, and other precision instruments between 1850 and 1957. The pocket watch within this conversion was produced by Waltham in 1914 and clearly showcases the company's commitment to high-quality craftsmanship. A radiant cream-colored dial with raised gold numerals and unique textural elements is accented by blued steel moon hands. Our machined stainless steel case with open case back reveals an ornately decorated movement engraved with the original manufacturer's initials. We paired this piece with a tan leather strap for a comfortable and eye-catching conversation piece for your wrist.

watches.name: The Springfield 046 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 046 unique: Featuring an Illinois Watch Company pocket watch manufactured in 1927, this conversion certainly has some stories to tell! You can see the 96 years' worth of seconds and minutes counted by the original blued kite hands and patinaed dial. If you flip the watch over, the 'Autocrat' grade movement is still ticking away, accurate as ever. We've contrasted the antiquity of this piece with our modern stainless steel dial and crown and paired it with a classic black leather strap so it can be worn and loved again for another 96 years.

watches.name: The Boston 010 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Boston 010 unique: This was built for our collectors waiting for “the one.” Every single thing about this watch is rare. The dial is a nearly perfect double-sunk example made with grand feu enamel. The movement is a pristine example of the Waltham Maximus, one of their highest grades. With 23 jewels and stunning decoration on all components, you’ll have to take this off to show your friends the exhibition back. The movement and dial are also one of the older ones we’ve restored recently. It was built by Waltham in Massachusetts in 1903. Only 300 Maximus models were made in this style which is a small number considering the total production of the Waltham Watch Company was over 40,000,000 movements. We decided to use a steel case complete with a coin-edge bezel with a matte black DLC coating.

watches.name: The Springfield 048 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 048 unique: This watch is spectacular! The Springfield 048 features a pocket watch originally manufactured in 1922 by the Illinois Watch Company as a private-label piece for the Rosenfield-Simone Jewelry Company of St. Joseph, Missouri. Illinois movements made for that company were marked "Federal" and had these unique waves machined into them. We can't decide if we like the front or the back of this timepiece better - the dial, with its 'freckled' patina and ornate engravings, almost glows in the light, and the open case back reveals a 21-jewel movement with a sunburst pattern. We opted for a stainless steel case with a coin-edged bezel and a tobacco leather strap to complete the conversion. This 45mm Vortic watch certainly has some stories to tell.

watches.name: The Lancaster 032 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Lancaster 032 unique: Hamilton Watch Company made some of the highest quality pocket watches in the late 1800s and early 1900s, and the pocket watch within the Lancaster 032 is a testament to that enduring legacy. This two-toned gold dial with a concentric circular pattern catches the light and draws the eye outward to raised Art Deco numerals. We've paired this piece with our machined stainless steel case and matched the blued steel gothic hands with an eye-catching blue leather strap.

watches.name: The Springfield 047 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 047 unique: The Springfield 047 is a stunning timepiece that beautifully revives a 1927 Illinois pocket watch. With its gold hands, applied Art Deco numerals, and an intricate silver cutout, this dial is nothing less than a showstopper. We've paired it with our precision-machined stainless steel case, a bronze crown, and a coin-edged bronze bezel to highlight the interplay of metals in the original piece and paired it with a timeless black leather strap. Regardless of what you wear, this watch will elevate any look and be sure to draw attention.

watches.name: The Springfield 040 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 040 unique: Featuring an Illinois pocket watch originally manufactured in 1926, The Springfield 040 is a unique and stylish statement piece for your wrist. The original cream dial with gold numerals and accents is perfectly complemented by our sandblasted satin finish bronze case and crenelated bezel. Similarly, the blued steel kite hands pair well with the eye-catching blue leather strap, and we've rounded out the look with a stainless steel crown. This conversion strikes a wonderful balance between antique and modern.

watches.name: The Springfield 045 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 045 unique: This eye-catching Illinois pocket watch has been brought back to life in stunning fashion! Originally manufactured in 1916, the rich gold dial with geometric design elements and a scalloped edge features gothic numerals and blued steel hands. Flip the watch over to discover that this was a private label piece made for Kay Jewelry Company which opened the same year this pocket watch was made. We've completed the conversion with a coin-edge stainless steel dial, bronze crown, and a luxurious red leather strap for an unforgettable timepiece.

watches.name: The Military Edition - 2023 Special Edition
watches.description: SOLD OUT in only 5 minutes ... thank you for the support! Sign up for the Waiting List so you don't miss next year's Military Edition. The 2023 Special Edition of the Military Edition Series is officially our new favorite watch. We're only building 10 of these... ever, and we've used a new material to make them even more special. It's been a massive learning experience working with this new Mokume material for the bezel and crown, and we're so excited to share it with you in this year's Special Edition. This is the first watch from Vortic to feature Mokume, a unique material that looks similar to Damascus Steel, but has layers of brass, copper, and nickel-silver. The bezel and crown are made from Mokume and the case is made from bronze, all machined here in our Fort Collins, Colorado manufacturing facility. It looks awesome now, but just wait until it starts to patina... The movement inside is also special. We found 10 antique Hamilton movements from the early days of World War II, all marked "US GOVT." This marking was only done to about 10% of the total production of those Army Air Corps movements. We donate $500 from each watch to the Veterans Watchmaker Initiative , which trains disabled military vets how to become professional watchmakers. The average unemployment rate for disabled war veterans is 82%, and the funds we donate will put a dent in that figure! Check out the National News Story for more details on the Veterans Watchmaker Initiative. Please note that slight variations in the dials, movements, and hands may occur as they are all unique pieces made about 80 years ago. See our Military Edition Information page for more information on the product line in general as well as images of previous editions going back to 2019.

watches.name: The Military Edition - Fifth Edition
watches.description: SOLD OUT in less than 24 hours! Sign up for the Waiting List for next year so you don't miss out again! The Military Edition: Fifth Edition for 2023 Vortic’s only limited edition, the Military Edition, is a set of wristwatches built from very special antique American pocket watches. The pocket watches inside these wristwatches were originally manufactured for the U.S. Army Air Corps and flown on the B-17s and similar bomber aircraft in World War II. It’s the ultimate military watch and has the most provenance of any product we’ve ever made. Scroll down to read more about our Military Edition series. Every watch in the Fifth Edition contains an original antique Hamilton 4992B movement. Please note we are only making 20 pieces this year, and they may sell quickly. It takes us all year to source these original antique movements, but we now have a consistent, albeit slow, supply. Each piece will be uniquely serial numbered and come with a certificate of authenticity. The Fifth Edition features a stainless steel case with a DLC-black coating and our new "stepped" lug design, plus a hand-painted red second hand and custom black strap with red stitching. In the box, you'll also find a second strap made from green military canvas as well as the screwdriver you'll need to change it. We donate $500 from each watch to the Veterans Watchmaker Initiative , which trains disabled military vets how to become professional watchmakers. The average unemployment rate for disabled war veterans is 82%, and the funds we donate will put a dent in that figure! Check out the National News Story for more details on the Veterans Watchmaker Initiative. Please note that slight variations in the dials, movements, and hands may occur as they are all unique pieces made about 80 years ago. See our Military Edition Information page for more information on the product line in general as well as images of previous editions going back to 2019.

watches.name: The Lancaster 027 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Lancaster 027 unique: We're so thrilled with how this watch turned out and think you will be too! This antique 1923 dial features one of Hamilton Watch Company's rarest designs from the early 1900s - the indices on the main dial and the sub-second dial are raised from ornate cutouts on the dial plate. A bronze case and crown perfectly accentuate the metallic face, while the open case back reveals a perfectly restored 17-jewel movement. Blued steel kite hands and a rich brown leather strap complete the majestic feel of this unforgettable timepiece.

watches.name: The Springfield 041 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 041 unique: Originally manufactured in 1927, this pocket watch conversion is a testament to the timeless design and craftsmanship of the Illinois Watch Company. A cream dial is accompanied by gold numerals and delicate gothic hands that accent the gold-plated gears of the 17-jewel movement. We've contrasted these elements with our machined stainless steel case and crown and paired them with a cordovan leather oxblood strap, resulting in a sophisticated and elegant timepiece that will surely draw attention.

watches.name: The Chicago 040 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Chicago 040 unique: At first glance, The Chicago 040 looks like a classic black-and-white-dialed pocket watch conversion, but upon closer inspection, this one is something special. We've taken a 1918 Elgin pocket watch with hand-painted Masonic symbols and given it new life in our sleek stainless steel case with an exhibition back. Flip this piece over, and you'll see the original movement is just as intricate as the dial, not to be outshone by a straightforward tobacco leather strap. The resulting timepiece is truly a piece of American history and a conversation piece, to say the least.

watches.name: The Boston 011 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Boston 011 unique: This watch is simply stunning! Featuring a 1901 Waltham movement with a clean white dial and sleek moon hands, the Boston 011 truly is a statement piece. We've enclosed this hunting-style timepiece in a polished stainless steel case and paired it with a cordovan black leather strap for a classic, and classy, look and feel.

watches.name: The Lancaster 029 (43mm)
watches.description: What makes the Lancaster 029 unique: 43mm is the smallest size of pocket watch conversion that we can make, and we love how this one turned out! The Lancaster 029 is crafted from a 10-size Hamilton pocket watch enclosed in our machined stainless steel case and paired with a stitched black leather strap. The clean lines of the dial and gold hour indices and hands give this watch a classic feel that complements casual and dressy wear alike.

watches.name: The Springfield 043 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 043 unique: Originally manufactured in 1926, t his 12-size Illinois pocket watch has been meticulously restored and given new life as a stunning wristwatch. We love how much character this piece has — you can actually see the history in the hands and the dial — so we paired it with a bronze case and rich blue leather strap to contrast and highlight the antique centerpiece. Flip the watch over to expose the open case back, though, and you'll never guess that the movement was made almost 100 years ago. This one is truly unique!

watches.name: The Lancaster 031 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Lancaster 031 unique: Featuring an ornate, floral engraved dial and 17-jewel Hamilton movement, this pocket watch conversion is a showstopper. We've encased the original 1937 pocket watch and blued spade hands in our machined stainless steel case with polished bezel and paired it with an oxblood cordovan leather strap. The resulting wristwatch is a striking homage to American craftsmanship.

watches.name: The Lancaster 030 (43mm)
watches.description: What makes the Lancaster 030 unique: Hamilton Watch Company made amazing timepieces, dominating the watchmaking scene when it came to quality, and this movement is no exception. Set with 21 jewels and a clean dial, you will love wearing this now modern watch. We have preserved this 10-size pocket watch, the smallest that we are able to convert, in our modern stainless steel case and crown and paired it with a classic tan strap.

watches.name: The Springfield 042 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 042 unique: This amazing watch carries the legacy of Illinois Watch Co. and the heart of American watchmaking. Originally manufactured in 1917, this movement tells the history of watchmaking in the early 1900s. With 17 jewels and a textured silver center dial, we decided the machined stainless steel was the way to go for this conversion. Simple and neat is the direction we went for this watch, which is reflected in the use of a simple black strap. You will love wearing this watch.

watches.name: The Chicago 039 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Chicago 039 unique: This blacked-out case helps the dial pop on this watch. With a silver crown to pull your eye across the top and onto the strap, you will love this timepiece. Elgin Watch Company made many fine watches in its day, and this one is no exception. Set with 17 jewels and crafted in 1921, the movement is a relic of watch-making created to last a lifetime. Now set in our modern case, and expertly serviced by our watchmakers, it will last another.

watches.name: The Springfield 039 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 039 unique: This beauty was originally manufactured in 1923 and set with 17 jewels, bringing real meaning to the word 'vintage.' With a rustic dial and bronze crown, this Springfield will stand out on your wrist. Illinois Watch Co. spared no detail in crafting this movement, and with our modern stainless steel case and case back, you can marvel at the timeless craftsmanship of days past. Nestled between a merlot leather strap, you will love wearing this watch.

watches.name: The Lancaster 025 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Lancaster 025 unique: This beautiful watch was originally manufactured in 1930 by Hamilton Watch Co. Set with 17 jewels, this movement was built to last a lifetime, and now in a modern case, it will last another. The blued hands complement the strap, and the crown exemplifies the numbers. With our stainless steel case, bronze crown, and lovely blue strap you will feel great wearing this watch. A time piece that stands the test of time, now in a beautiful wristwatch.

watches.name: The Springfield 038 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 038 unique: This vintage 12-size pocket watch is now reborn as a contemporary wristwatch. With a remarkable 17-jewel movement at its core, precision and reliability are guaranteed. Encased in a gleaming stainless steel case that has been meticulously polished to a brilliant shine, the watch exudes a sense of modern sophistication. The coined bezel not only adds a touch of classic elegance but also showcases attention to detail. This transformation seamlessly blends the best of the old and new, making it a timeless accessory that combines precision, style, and durability.

watches.name: The Chicago 035 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Chicago 035 unique: This 12-size Elgin pocket watch has been transformed into a distinctive wristwatch, seamlessly blending the best of classic craftsmanship with modern wearability. The heart of this watch boasts a meticulously crafted movement with a jewel count of 17, ensuring precision and longevity. Housed in a stunning bronze case, this wristwatch reflects the heritage of American watchmaking and stands out as a unique and timeless accessory, ready to accompany you on your daily journey with both style and substance.

watches.name: The Springfield 037 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 037 unique: This pocket watch conversion combines elegance with modern functionality. A classic timepiece encased in durable stainless steel that stands out as unique and resilient, true to Illinois Watch Co. Its tan leather strap adds a touch of warmth and comfort to the design, making it an ideal accessory for any occasion. With a nod to tradition and style, this pocket watch conversion will complement your daily attire and catch any onlooker's eye.

watches.name: The Chicago 037 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Chicago 037 unique: The transformation of this 1924 Elgin pocket watch into a wristwatch is a testament to the timeless elegance of horological craftsmanship. This 17-jewel masterpiece, now ensconced within a rich bronze case, has seamlessly adapted to the modern era. The dial, with its classic design, serves as a perfect complement to the robust bronze case and crown. The juxtaposition of the vintage aesthetic with the rugged, patinated bronze evokes a sense of nostalgia and durability, reminding us that the passage of time can be both beautiful and enduring. This transformed timepiece is a true fusion of history and contemporary style, a wristwatch that not only tells time but also tells a story.

watches.name: The Chicago 036 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Chicago 036 unique: Elevate your timekeeping with this classic Elgin pocket watch, meticulously crafted and set with 17 jewels to enhance accuracy and durability. This vintage-inspired timepiece has received a contemporary upgrade, now encased in a sleek stainless steel housing that offers both style and protection. The watch's dial exudes elegance, boasting a pristine white backdrop that serves as the perfect canvas for timekeeping that captivates your gaze. The Roman numerals gracing the dial provide a touch of vintage sophistication to the overall design. And don't miss the sub-dial, a feature that not only enhances precision but also adds a layer of complexity to the watch's aesthetic.

watches.name: The Burlington 004 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Burlington 004 unique: This vintage 21-jewel pocket watch from 1925 has been beautifully transformed into a modern wristwatch. Encased in sandblasted steel, the watch exudes a timeless charm with its aged patina, capturing the essence of its original manufacturing era. Its navy blue strap complements the steel case, adding a contemporary touch while preserving the watch's classic appeal. This unique fusion of history and modernity results in a one-of-a-kind timepiece that bridges the gap between the past and present.

watches.name: The Chicago 034 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Chicago 034 unique: A masterpiece born from the dedication and craftsmanship of the Elgin Watch Company, and originally crafted in 1920, this timeless pocketwatch movement has been transformed into a unique wristwatch. The vintage charm of its oxidated dial, with its weathered and rusted aesthetic, reflects the history it carries within. The heart of this watch is a testament to the enduring legacy of Elgin Watch Co, showcasing its unwavering commitment to precision and quality. Encased in modern stainless steel, this timepiece harmoniously blends the classic with the contemporary. The bronze crown adds a touch of elegance, while the tan strap provides comfort and style. This conversion is not just a watch; it's a journey through time, a symbol of craftsmanship, and a reminder of the enduring dedication of American watchmaking.

watches.name: The Lancaster 024 (43mm)
watches.description: What makes the Lancaster 024 unique: This vintage pocket watch, originally manufactured in 1938, has been meticulously serviced and now resides in a modern stainless steel wristwatch case. This remarkable timepiece combines the timeless elegance of a vintage watch with the durability and aesthetics of modern design. One of the striking features of this watch is the dial and hands, both of which complement the strap color, playing a crucial role in enhancing its simplicity. Hamilton worked hard to craft beautiful movements and dials, and we believe this watch exemplifies just that.

watches.name: The Springfield 035 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 035 unique: This classic Illinois movement, first manufactured in 1923, sits beautifully in our modern stainless steel case. This timepiece exudes timeless elegance with its vintage-inspired design and meticulous attention to detail. The stainless steel case not only offers durability but also a contemporary touch, seamlessly blending the past and present. The merlot strap helps the cream dial stand out as the hands tick by. The amazing craftsmanship of this movement illustrates Illinois' passion and drive for high-quality work, and our new case, crown, and strap bring this old watch back to life.

watches.name: The Chicago 539 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Chicago 539 unique: This beautiful Elgin timepiece stands out with its blued stainless steel case and strap. The crown reflects the beauty of the dial and contrasts the subdial with ease. Elgin was no stranger to creating beautiful American watches, and this modern case showcases its hard work and dedication to the craft. With an absolutely stunning movement that complements the overall design, wearing this watch on your wrist is a choice you can't go wrong with.

watches.name: The Chicago 033 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Chicago 033 unique: This Elgin movement, originally manufactured in 1925 and adorned with 17 jewels, is a classic and timeless masterpiece of watchmaking craftsmanship. This particular movement is complemented by a beautifully and meticulously crafted dial that showcases Elgin's commitment to elegance. Now set within a modern watch case made of bronze, featuring a bronze crown, stainless steel bezel, and a tan strap, it seamlessly blends vintage charm with contemporary finesse.

watches.name: The Springfield 034 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 034 unique: At the heart of this watch is the original movement manufactured by the Illinois Watch Co. in 1926. It is now housed in a one-of-a-kind Vortic case that has been carefully crafted for this dial. We put a lot of effort into these vintage movements, ensuring their accuracy and longevity, as well as the cases that hold them, and this watch is no exception. With luminous hands and numbers, a bronze case, a bronze crown, and a matching bezel, this watch showcases the unique beauty of its time period while seamlessly blending it with a modern look.

watches.name: The Lancaster 023 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Lancaster 023 unique: A masterpiece of horology, this pocket watch movement embodies the craftsmanship and precision of the Hamilton Watch Company. Originally manufactured in 1926, it has witnessed the passage of time like a silent observer. It has recently undergone meticulous servicing and maintenance and has been carefully placed in our stainless steel case to preserve the original craftsmanship. This harmonious marriage of vintage elegance and modern innovation brings the Hamilton back to life - its intricate gears and jewels continue to keep time with unwavering accuracy, reminding us of the enduring legacy of American watchmaking excellence.

watches.name: The Canton 002 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Canton 002 unique: We have transformed this classic 17-jewel pocket watch into a stylish and functional wristwatch, combining vintage craftsmanship with modern convenience. The original pocket watch, originally manufactured in 1913, has been meticulously reimagined and fitted into a blackened stainless steel case, preserving it for future generations. Merging the past and present to create one-of-a-kind wristwatches is what we do best, and this conversion is another homage to horological history.

watches.name: The Lancaster 022 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Lancaster 022 unique: Hamilton Watch Company made watches of all kinds. From low-grade 15-jewel movements to top end 23-jewels, and everything in between. This watch is an example of that broad spectrum. This 17-jewel movement is set in a modern case and has been revamped and rebuilt to keep time for another 96 years. This 45mm watch sits on the wrist perfectly and the bronze crown complements the coined edge bezel. Delicate hands placed over the parchment-colored dial bring this watch home.

watches.name: The Lancaster 017 (43mm)
watches.description: What makes the Lancaster 017 unique: Another marvel from Hamilton Watch Co, and a true gem at that. With 17 jewels and a stainless steel case, you will love wearing this watch. The gold hands complement the light brown stitched strap, just as they balance the dial and numbers. Hamilton worked hard to provide excellent work to the American people, and this movement is an exquisite example of just that. Originally manufactured in 1949 and still ticking strong today, the Lancaster 017 is a testament to time.

watches.name: The Springfield 033 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 003 unique: A black stitched strap and stainless steel case make this watch simple but stunning. The gold color of the dial stands out against the many attributes of this watch and adds to the beauty of the Illinois watchmaker's hard work. This 19-jewel movement adds a touch of class and style to any look.

watches.name: The Lancaster 014 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Lancaster 014 unique: Contrasted against a bronze case and crown is the silver sub-dial of this 1927 Hameltion pocket watch movement. The soft brown and moss of the strap make this watch a simple but brilliant piece. Over 2,000 watches have been patiently and lovingly crafted behind our doors, and over half of them have passed through the hands of our head watchmaker, Derek. This particular watch is Derek's 1,000th and a masterpiece grade at that. Set with 23 jewels and a gold-plated gear train, this movement is truly fitting of a masterpiece collaboration. You can see the time and care put into this movement and that is reflected in Derek's work as well. See an exclusive look behind the scenes on YouTube by watching our new video "The Man Who Built 1,000 Watches" here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tzG7oXKok-c

watches.name: The Chicago 028 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Chicago 028 unique: This elegant watch was first manufactured by Elgin Watch Company in 1920. With only 14,000 in production, this Lord Elgin-grade movement is truly a rare find. We have set this movement with a polished bezel and machined stainless steel case that draws your eye to the dial. Gold Roman numerals, center dial engravings, and black hands make this watch a masterpiece of its time.

watches.name: The Springfield 608 (47mm)
watches.description: What makes the Springfield 608 unique: A black strap and complementary black case set this watch apart from others. We chose to match the crown to the center of the dial to help things really pop! This impressive pocket watch turned wristwatch was originally manufactured in 1917 by Illinois Watch Company. Producing millions of movements, Illinois truly captured the beauty of the era and developed a name for itself through quality and craftsmanship. This watch is no exception and we feel as though it encapsulates the many unique qualities an Illinois.

watches.name: The Lancaster 020 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Lancaster 020 unique: This Hamilton has a one-of-a-kind dial that complements the strap color and hands. The gold numbering and rustic look of this watch face begs for attention. Originally manufactured in 1931 the movement is set in our stainless steel case only to add to the timelessness and craftsmanship of Hamilton Watch Co. Wearing this watch means sharing a piece of American history with you wherever you go.

watches.name: The Lancaster 010 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Lancaster 010 unique: As the market demand for smaller watches increased in the early 1920s Hamilton Watch Co was there to fulfill the consumer's needs, and this 12-size movement is an extraordinary example of just that. The dial shines brilliantly against our bronze case allowing the hands to pop out at you. The merlot strap adds a subtle hint of color and grace to this watch that will captivate any onlooker. If you are looking for a watch that tells a story, reflects history, and will get people talking you have come to the right place.

watches.name: The Boston 009 (45mm)
watches.description: What makes the Boston 009 unique: The Roaring 20s were filled with jazz, dance, and speakeasies, all of which had a lasting impression on the art and culture of the United States. American craftsmanship was at its peak during this time, and Waltham was no exception, making many timepieces that fit the style and excitement of that era, like the Boston 009. With a meticulously carved dial and manually machined movement, Waltham captures the essence of the early 1920s in this watch. Now set in our stainless steel machined case, matching crown, and dark brown strap, you too can appreciate the beauty of this watch and carry a small piece of the Roaring 20s with you.
